before_ingredients_html:
Simplified version

Use a bag of washed rocket and a small pack of pomegranate seeds. Omit nuts, onion and molasses. In Armenia, use a mild white brined cheese; taste before adding salt.
blurb_html: Peppery leaves, juicy pomegranate and salty cheese: a modern Turkish-style side.

steps.body_html:
• Rinse rocket with drinking-quality water unless the pack says ready to eat.
  • Dry very well in a towel or spinner so dressing clings.
  • Remove tough stalk ends.
steps.title: Wash and dry the leaves

steps.body_html:
• If using a whole pomegranate, score only the skin and pull into sections; lift out seeds and discard white pith.
  • Measure 80 g. Drain cheese and break into 1–2 cm pieces.
  • Prepare and reserve optional onion and roughly broken walnuts for serving.
steps.title: Prepare seeds and cheese

steps.body_html:
• Stir oil and lemon with optional molasses.
  • Toss rocket with about two-thirds of the dressing.
  • Add cheese and seeds, then fold once; crushing them makes the leaves wet and pink.
steps.title: Dress lightly

steps.body_html:
• Taste a leaf with cheese before adding optional salt.
  • Add remaining dressing only if needed; scatter optional onion and walnuts.
  • Eat while leaves are upright and crisp.
steps.title: Taste and serve immediately
